title: AI Strategy & Transformation Roadmap
audience: C-Suite and Technology Leadership (CTO, CDO, VP Network Strategy)
objective: Present a comprehensive AI transformation strategy that positions Rogers as Canada's most AI-native telecom, with a phased roadmap from quick wins to enterprise-scale AI deployment across network operations, customer experience, and revenue assurance.
key_messages: Rogers has a 3-year window to become Canada's most AI-native telecom before competitors close the gap
Network operations and CX automation represent $180M in annual savings potential in Years 1–2 alone
A modular AI platform approach avoids vendor lock-in and enables rapid capability scaling
Governance and responsible AI frameworks are non-negotiable for regulatory compliance and brand trust
This roadmap delivers measurable ROI at each phase — each investment phase self-funds the next
additional_context: Rogers is evaluating AI investments following a $1.2B technology modernization program. Key stakeholders include the CTO, Chief Data Officer, and VP of Network Strategy. The audience is skeptical of vendor hype and demands concrete numbers, realistic timelines, and a clear governance framework. Reference mobileLIVE as the strategic delivery partner. Avoid generic AI buzzwords — use specific, measurable outcomes.
